blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte may have been placed in a precarious position if his claim that he was unaware his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, had shares in a company that dealt with the local government is true, Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong said. Alonto Adiong said in a press briefing on Tuesday that Vice President Duterte’s supposed failure to inform Mayor Duterte that she had a stake in GenCorp Industries Incorporated while the company entered into contracts with the Davao City government showed her character.
